title: checklist: re-point 21 stale items in integration-system, automation, area-level recipes (v18.4.0 sweep close-out, batch E of #32908)
body:
domain:devx#4 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5ooRyyS95kdyC2dPEX

Filing gate: ① checklist assertion defects (#32997 rule 9): each item below will score FAIL or mislead a QA run while the product is right, or names a fixture recipe that no longer works.
Parent: #32908, the v18.4.0 sweep anchor. Its §1 close-out was measured in one pass on `origin/main` `87330e89` (report 6881013689 on #32908): 269 parked lines, 171 of them owe an item-text re-point over 159 items. That is too large for one PR, so the seat splits it by area file into five batches with no shared file. This card is batch E.

**Business reason:** every stale clause costs the next release sweep a false FAIL and a re-judgement, and a stale fixture recipe costs a run its setup time.
**Reader:** the `domain:devx` seat 4 (claim follows), then QA runs reading these areas.
**Dedupe:** the rows below are the parked lines of #32908 that are still stale on `87330e89`. PR #33273 (merged) and #33275 (in flight) re-point other items and are excluded. No other open card re-points these items.

## Fix shape
For each row: re-measure on current `main` first (area files move under product PRs); re-point the text to the product, bump `revision`, add a `history` row citing this card and the source record. A row the re-measure finds already right is left alone and said so in the PR. `pnpm check:platform-checklist` green. Files: `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/integration-system.json`, `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/automation.json` and the area-level recipe text the rows name only.
